crossRefs.note: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.
When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer.
I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is…

translations.web: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
translations.bsb: Through my loud groaning my skin hangs on my bones.
translations.kjv: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
translations.asv: By reason of the voice of my groaning My bones cleave to my flesh.
